note: Lynchburg/Moore County campground in Wiseman Park, a short walk from the downtown square and the Jack Daniel Distillery. Only sites 1-4 have RV electric; the 20-amp outlets at sites 5-18 do not support an RV hookup, and site 5 has no water. Sites 5-18 line East Fork Mulberry Creek, and the county warns the campground is in a flood zone. Access runs through the town square - tight during festivals but passable for a 23-ft rig. --Claude
